args.body: Hello, thank you for letting us in for the inspection. Two things from the report and the landlord: 1) A dog flap has been fitted in the back door/utility room. Changes like this need the landlord's written consent under the tenancy's alterations clause (and pets clause). Did you get consent, and if so can you send us a copy? 2) The landlord says the front door lock has been changed and asks for a spare key. Our records don't show a lock change. Who changed it and when? Please get a spare key to our office by Friday 23 February. Also, the report notes sticker marks from command strips on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window; please remove them and make good. We'll update you by 23 February.
